entities.name: Nitric oxide dioxygenation to nitrate
observations: Proposed overall reaction: 2 nitric oxide + NAD(P)H + 2 O2 → 2 nitrate + NAD(P)+ + H+.
The reaction is associated with EC 1.14.12.17 and Rhea RHEA:19465/RHEA:19469 in reviewed flavohemoprotein homologs.
The query sequence is inferred to catalyze this reaction from strong homology; it was not directly assayed here.

source_tools.relevance: Curated catalytic annotations and reaction mappings from close reviewed homologs.

entities.name: Flavohemoprotein cofactors
observations: Close reviewed homologs bind one heme b and one FAD per subunit; the globin and reductase architecture is consistent with these cofactors.
Cofactor assignment for the query is homology-based rather than experimentally verified.
